host_qualification.rule: Seed, Final r1 and the public reproductions run on one host with one set of pinned host tools. ELF, LTO object, PRG and D81 must be byte-identical to the Final. The merged bitcode written by /usr/bin/llvm-link is an intermediate, not an artifact: it is recorded, must agree between the two reproductions, and its equality with the file the Final wrote is recorded, not required.

repl_seam.rule: replay input = frozen Comfort-default repl.c + the mem_oom landing hunk; carried as bytes, never re-derived in the public build
